title: Decide who performs Phase 5's gate run
description:
u9h asks for an operational exercise, not a diff: run a real epic on the DEPLOYED Factory (https://ticks-factory.pe-1a0.workers.dev, verified live 2026-09-20 with every credential checking out), with max_parallel > 1, restart the Workflow mid-attempt so adoption by identity is exercised on the cloud host, and report the intervention count from recorded data.

Two GLM worker attempts produced an empty branch (attempt 20, 20 minutes; attempt 21, 11 minutes). That is the expected outcome, not a defect: a worker in a git worktree has no natural way to produce a live cloud exercise as a commit. Retrying spends a go6 intervention each time - six of twelve were gone by 16:40 - and cannot converge.

This tick exists so a person decides, deliberately, rather than the cap absorbing it. Three options:

1. The session lead performs the run and commits the recorded evidence (feed lines, intervention count, adoption proof) as u9h's deliverable. Needs the operator's go: it spends real Workers AI budget in the operator's Cloudflare account and writes to the PUBLIC pengelbrecht/ticks repo.
2. Split u9h into deploy-and-verify / run-a-small-epic / restart-mid-attempt, so the parts that ARE code go to workers.
3. The operator performs it, if any step needs their account interactively.

u9h is blocked by this tick meanwhile, so the run stops cycling on it and stops spending interventions. u9h is NOT closed and NOT skipped: the epic still cannot complete without it, which is the whole reason it exists - Phase 4 shipped without a gate run because no tick owned it.
acceptance_criteria: A person has chosen who performs the gate run, and u9h is unblocked with that decision recorded on it
closed_reason: Decided by doing it. The operator approved the gate run on 2026-09-20 and I performed it against the deployed factory over that night: deploy, a small throwaway epic in ticks (uzc), max_parallel > 1, and four successive runs. It found nineteen defects invisible to the test suite, seven of which are merged (ant, 63i, 0h9, eg9, 8xd, 99f, q35), and established that the cloud orchestration is hosted in the wrong place - which is yoh. So the answer to 'who performs the gate run' is settled and u9h no longer waits on a decision.
